## Problem
Game contributors need varied, custom 8-bit sound effects (coin clinks, laser blasts, jump chirps, explosions) but are constrained to a few hardcoded sound triggers in `audio.js` because external audio samples are forbidden.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **In-Browser Retro SFX Synthesizer Studio (`assets/js/sfx-studio.js`):**
   - A standalone developer laboratory accessible via `ideas.html` or developer mode modal.
   - Provides sliders for Envelope (Attack, Sustain, Decay), Frequency (Base, Minimum, Slide, Delta Slide), Vibrato (Depth, Speed), and Modulation (Duty Cycle, Flanger, Bitcrush).
2. **Algorithmic One-Click Quick Presets:**
   - Quick generation buttons for retro archetypes: `Laser`, `Explosion`, `Coin`, `Power-Up`, `Hit/Hurt`, and `Jump`.
   - Real-time oscilloscope visualization showing the active waveform.
3. **Zero-Dependency JSON Preset Export & Runtime Playback:**
   - Exports pure JSON parameter objects that contributors can paste directly into their game code.
   - Exposes `ArcadeVerse.audio.playSfx(presetJson)` for instantaneous playback in any game.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Generates authentic 8-bit sound effects using pure Web Audio API oscillator/gain/biquad nodes.
- [ ] Instant one-click copy of JSON parameters to clipboard with visual toast feedback.
- [ ] Verified zero external dependencies and responsive layout across desktop and mobile screens.

#### Issue Specification
- **Level:** `level3` (10 points)
- **Labels:** `nsoc26, level3, feature, vfx, performance`

## Problem
Many arcade games in the catalog generate garbage collection spikes and micro-stutters during intense action sequences because they instantiate and discard hundreds of temporary particle objects `new Particle()` every frame, causing garbage collection frame drops.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Pre-Allocated Object-Pooled Particle Engine (`assets/js/arcade-particles.js`):**
   - Allocates a fixed buffer pool of 1,000 reusable particle structs upon initialization, recycling dead particles with zero per-frame heap allocations.
2. **Versatile Preset Emitter Types:**
   - Includes built-in emitter configurations: `Sparks`, `Fireball`, `Smoke Puff`, `Neon Confetti`, `Shockwave Ring`, and `Pixel Explosion`.
   - Supports velocity damping, gravity vectors, alpha fading, color gradients, and size interpolation.
3. **Unified Game API:**
   - Simple global helper: `ArcadeVerse.vfx.burst(x, y, presetName, { count, color, speed })`.
   - Auto-bounds rendering to the active game canvas context.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Zero allocations during continuous active particle emission (confirmed via memory timeline).
- [ ] Maintains steady 60 FPS even when simultaneously rendering 500+ active particles.
- [ ] Automatically halts and recycles all particles if user switches tabs or closes the game modal.

## Problem
Music and rhythmic game mechanics in ArcadeVerse are currently decoupled from real-time audio playback, relying on rigid static timers (`setInterval`) that drift out of sync with actual audio playback during frame drops.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Spectral Flux Onset Detection Engine (`assets/js/rhythm-beat-detector.js`):**
   - Connects an `AnalyserNode` to the Web Audio master output.
   - Calculates real-time spectral flux (positive rate of change in spectral energy across sub-bands) to detect authentic rhythmic transients (kicks, snares, chiptune pulses).
2. **Dynamic Thresholding & Peak Pick:**
   - Implements adaptive median filtering over a rolling 1-second window to prevent false-positive beat triggers during noisy gameplay.
3. **Custom Event Bus for Visual Pulsing:**
   - Fires `'arcade-beat'` DOM events with peak intensity values $(0.0 - 1.0)$, allowing UI borders, particle emitters, and game backgrounds to pulse in lockstep with the rhythm.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Accurately detects rhythm peaks across various chiptune tempos (80 - 160 BPM).
- [ ] Under 1ms CPU processing time per audio buffer frame.
- [ ] Cleanly disconnects audio nodes without leaking audio memory when games terminate.

   - Computes horizon angle, camera elevation, scale factors, and rotational affine coordinates $(A, B, C, D)$.
2. **Interactive Parameter Sandbox on `ideas.html`:**
   - Real-time parameter controls for Field of View, Camera Pitch, Horizon Altitude, and Texture Tiling.
   - Displays a dual view: top-down source map on the left, rendered pseudo-3D perspective plane on the right.
3. **Reusable Helper Module for Game Creators:**
   - Exposes `ArcadeVerse.math.createMode7Renderer(ctx, tilemapData)` so contributors can build retro kart racers or flight sims.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Pure 2D Canvas scanline affine rendering without Three.js or WebGL.
- [ ] Achieves rock-solid 60 FPS at $320 \times 240$ retro rendering resolution.
- [ ] Complete inline mathematical documentation explaining projection formulas.

## Problem
Boss monsters, alien tentacles, grappling ropes, and robotic arms in arcade games are notoriously difficult to animate naturally using manual frame-by-frame sprites, often leading to stiff and repetitive enemy animations.

## Architectural Scope & Requirements
1. **Pure Vanilla FABRIK / CCD 2D IK Solver (`assets/js/inverse-kinematics-physics.js`):**
   - Implements the Forward And Backward Reaching Inverse Kinematics (FABRIK) algorithm for n-joint kinematic chains in 2D space.
   - Solves target reach positions iteratively within 3-5 iterations per frame with joint angle constraints (min/max angle limits).
2. **Procedural Multi-Tentacle & Mechanical Arm Generators:**
   - Built-in generators for segmented robotic arms, alien boss tentacles, and dynamic character limbs that automatically reach toward mouse/player targets.
3. **Modular Helper for Game Creators:**
   - Exposes `ArcadeVerse.physics.createIKChain(jointsCount, segmentLength, constraints)` for instant integration into boss fights and physics games.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Solves multi-segment kinematic chains in under 0.1ms per frame using FABRIK math.
- [ ] Realistic joint angular constraints preventing unnatural backward bending.
- [ ] Comprehensive unit tests verifying solver convergence and boundary clamping.
